verdict.rationale: Ramp's docs claim auto-receipt capture at the moment of card swipe with AI-filled memos and categories, and the CLI/API expose explicit receipts upload/attach and receipts:write scopes for matching receipts to transactions, directly supporting automatic attachment to the right transaction. Missing for 10: explicit mention of the classic 'email a receipt to Ramp' forwarding workflow and independent/user corroboration of receipt-matching accuracy.
